a CoNi-based FCC MPEA (Co44Ni44Mo9W3 alloy) was designed via alloying with refractory Mo and W. Despite being of single-phase structure, the alloy exhibited outstanding strength-ductility synergy
The Co44Ni44Mo9W3 alloy was synthesized by vacuum arc melting using high-purity metals ( > 99.9 %). The melt was drop-cast into a rectangular water-cooled mold with sizes of 60 mm × 30 mm × 10 mm.
The as-cast ingot was homogenized at 1250 °C for 12 h followed by water-quenching, and then cold-rolling (CR, with a reduction of 75 % in thickness) at RT.
